text: When Leo reached the eastern part of the village, he heard chickens clucking.
Near the oak trees, an elderly man was feeding the roosters.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: Are you Leo? You must be the new student Mira mentioned.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: Ah, good. Mira was a bit worried since you're new to Luntian.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: Oh, forgive me. Mira mentioned a new student, and I assumed it was you. I'm Mang Ben; let me know if you need help.
Leo noticed that Mang Ben spoke gently and seemed used to helping people in the village.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: Mira mentioned that your map is missing. Is that right?

speaker: Mang Ben
text: It's quite normal for newcomers to get lost here. Many paths in the village look alike.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: Good to hear. If you ever need help, don't hesitate to ask.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: Do you know how to sign yet, Leo?

speaker: Mang Ben
text: That's a good start. What matters most is that you keep learning.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: That's all right. Everyone starts somewhere, and you'll learn step by step.
As Leo listened to Mang Ben, he began to feel more comfortable in Luntian.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: If you'd like, I can accompany you to the plaza tomorrow. There's a lot you can learn there.
The sky slowly darkened as a peaceful night settled over Luntian.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: That's right. I hope you and your family are settling into the village.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: There are many friendly people here who can help you get to know Luntian.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: No need to apologize, Leo. Moving somewhere new can take time to get used to.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: Take your time. The paths will become familiar as you explore.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: If you get turned around again, just ask someone for directions.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: You're welcome, Leo. I'll be glad to help if you need anything.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: Good. Remember, you can always ask for help.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: You're welcome. Keep practicing at your own pace.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: Exactly. The more you practice, the more comfortable you'll become.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: You're welcome, Leo. I'll be happy to help you learn.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: That's right. You'll learn one sign at a time.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: Great! I'll meet you here tomorrow, and we can walk to the plaza together.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: Wonderful! We'll explore the plaza together tomorrow.
